facts.business: Paramount Communications Limited is amongst India's leading wire and cable manufacturers, delivering reliable, high-performance cable solutions across India and global markets for sectors including power transmission and distribution, railways, telecom, renewable energy, defence, space, data centers, construction, IT, and oil & gas.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield manufacturing facility at Narmadapuram, Madhya Pradesh

key_risks: Severe disruptions in the United States (US) market
Higher churn, increased cost of operations may impact margins negatively
Decline in tariffs in a hyper competitive scenario
Impact of Labour Codes on employee benefit expenses
facts.related_party_note: Land was in the name of erstwhile partnership firm i.e. Paramount Cable Corporation which was converted into this company, name change is yet to be transferred.
